items.title: ♻️ 英伟达首测 Vera Rubin NVL72，DeepSeek 实测吞吐暴涨 30 倍
items.title_zh: 英伟达Vera Rubin NVL72首测：吞吐提升30倍、成本降低35倍
items.title_en: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Debuts: 30x Throughput Gain on DeepSeek AI
items.summary: NVIDIA's first Vera Rubin NVL72 benchmark shows 30x throughput gain on DeepSeek coding agents and 35x cost reduction, alongside Groq 3 LPX and SpaceX deployment announcements.

items.title: FDA authorizes first wearable device that monitors ketone and blood sugar levels
items.title_zh: FDA批准首款可穿戴设备，持续监测酮体和血糖
items.title_en: FDA Authorizes First Wearable to Continuously Monitor Ketones and Blood Sugar
items.summary: FDA authorizes the first wearable device that continuously monitors both ketone levels and blood sugar, marking a notable advancement in diabetes and metabolic health management.

items.title: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra
items.title_zh: 苹果发布M6和M5 Ultra，性能与AI算力大幅跃升
items.title_en: Apple unveils M6 and M5 Ultra, boosting performance and AI compute
items.summary: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra chips, promising significant performance and AI compute gains, sparking extensive community discussion.

items.title: OpenAI Jalapeño: Better than Nvidia Blackwell
items.title_zh: OpenAI的Jalapeño芯片宣称能效优于英伟达Blackwell
items.title_en: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip claims efficiency edge over Nvidia Blackwell
items.summary: SemiAnalysis examines OpenAI's custom Jalapeño ASIC, comparing its TCO and performance per MW against Nvidia's Blackwell/Rubin, sparking discussion on the future of inference chips.

items.title: New Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
items.title_zh: 苹果发布搭载M5 Max与M5 Ultra的新Mac Studio，主打本地AI
items.title_en: Apple Unveils Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra for Local AI
items.summary: Apple announces the new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra, emphasizing powerful local AI performance with up to 1.2TB/s memory bandwidth.

items.title: Nitter project received cease and desist
items.title_zh: Nitter 收到停止函后全面下线
items.title_en: Nitter Shuts Down After Cease-and-Desist Letters
items.summary: The Nitter project received cease-and-desist letters, likely from X/Twitter, causing all instances to go down and sparking debate about the future of privacy-focused alternative frontends.

items.title: Firefox 157 will include JPEG XL by default on all platforms
items.title_zh: Firefox 157 将在所有平台默认启用 JPEG XL
items.title_en: Firefox 157 will enable JPEG XL by default on all platforms
items.summary: Firefox 157 will enable JPEG XL by default on all platforms, a notable step forward for the modern image format's adoption.

items.title: Starbase, LA
items.title_zh: SpaceX 正式宣布在路易斯安那州设立 Starbase LA 发射场
items.title_en: SpaceX Officially Announces Starbase LA Launch Site in Louisiana
items.summary: SpaceX officially announces Starbase LA, a new launch facility in Louisiana, sparking widespread community discussion about its technical and economic significance.
